title: Independent investigation of strain-dependent electronic structure in K0.5WTe2
difficulty_reasons: Three fixed strain states still require a method-independent periodic electronic-structure search, convergence study, reciprocal-space extrema/crossing analysis and orbital projection.
The agent must distinguish three gap characters and provide state-specific validation, with a bounded-failure path when a classification is unresolved.

data.description: Self-contained K0.5WTe2 P21/m crystal and explicitly named b-axis strain states.

required_deliverables.description: Independent hypotheses, validated per-state electronic-structure results and conclusion.
